llm_response.reason: The site displays multiple scam indicators: 1) Unrealistic and guaranteed high ROI claims (up to 80%), 2) Urgency and instant withdrawal promises, 3) Copy trading and automated growth schemes, 4) Lack of verifiable company information and recent domain registration with all owner details redacted, 5) Crypto-only deposit options, which are harder to track and typical of scams, and 6) Use of fake testimonials and pressure tactics. These match several investment scam characteristics outlined in the provided criteria.
